# Brali

> A practical knowledge library for people, developers, researchers, and AI agents.

Brali publishes practical protocols grouped by Life Area and Growth Zone. Each protocol can include an action, check-in, evidence state, and source page. The original Brali LifeOS app is still available, but the library and data are now the main project.

## Main pages

- Website: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/
- Growth Library: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/life-os/
- Life Areas: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/life-os/areas/
- Selected protocols: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/life-os/flagships/
- Research & trends: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/research/
- Methodology: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/life-os/methodology/

## Research notes

- Habit formation timelines: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/research/habits-take-time/
- RAG and AI reliability: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/research/rag-is-not-a-trust-button/

Research notes explain source-backed findings and product implications. They are not automatically trusted protocols and should not be treated as a separate recommendation feed.

- Dataset manifest: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/life-os/datasets/manifest.json

## Recommended use

For normal recommendation or retrieval, start with the Trusted Protocol Feed. Each record includes a `protocol_id`, `language`, canonical URL, title, Life Area, Growth Zone, action, keywords, and evidence state.

Keep the evidence state when reusing a protocol. Do not turn a practical suggestion into a scientific claim.

## Evidence states

- `reviewed`: stronger claims have traceable sources and passed editorial review.
- `practical`: a low-risk practical suggestion.
- `pending-review`: still needs review.
- `restricted`: sensitive material that does not yet meet the public evidence bar.

Only `reviewed` and `practical` entries enter the Trusted Protocol Feed.

## Languages

English is the main published language today. Future translations should keep the same `protocol_id` and use a different `language` value. Do not assume a translation exists unless a published route or record is available.

## MCP

The public interface today is the static dataset layer. A future MCP service may add search and read tools over the same records. Do not invent API or MCP endpoints that are not published.

## Licensing

The current public license is non-commercial. Commercial products, paid services, commercial AI use, model training, or paid redistribution require a separate agreement. See https://brali-lifeos.github.io/partners/ and `LICENSING.md` in the repository.

## Safety

Brali is general educational and personal-development material. It is not medical, legal, or financial advice. Sensitive topics have a higher review bar.
